name: Valenne Linen
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: individual material illustration for the Avarenne novel encyclopedia. Main subject: Unbleached ivory flax linen folded in broad sheets, an exposed plain weave edge and a small skein of matte flax thread on a clean cloth merchant table, daylight revealing coarse versus fine weave. Not glossy silk, not bandages on a body, no magic. Style: refined semi-realistic painted novel art, exquisite tactile detail and believable natural material behaviour, late industrial craft atmosphere. Landscape 3:2. One coherent close-up scene of this ONE material, with raw or worked examples of that same material only where requested; not a composite board of different materials. Use light and background suited to this specific material so its texture, silhouette and colour are immediately legible. No people, no readable letters or numerals, no labels, logo, watermark, card frame or infographic. Do not add supernatural effects to ordinary material. No extra tools or props that could be mistaken for a different catalogue specimen.
visual_caption: Campione illustrativo di Valenne Linen. Forma, colore e finitura aiutano a riconoscere il materiale; non certificano da soli purezza, provenienza o investimento.
visual_review: APPROVATA: materia, forma, texture e distinzione dagli altri campioni verificate
